items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I admired him very much... we would get together after the job and really get into playing... highlight of 1951 for me was working with this band.

ctx.x: Did Nat also never fire anybody?

No, I don't remember him firing anybody. Everybody quit when he got -- you know, ready to leave. But Nat was a very nice individual, very easy going. Oh, he was very nice. I admired him very much. And as I said, you know, about my not taking solos and all that, it was -- if I didn't want to stay there, if I didn't have reason for being there, I should have quit myself. It wasn't -- I could understand what he was doing. He's building Nat Cole, you know. No matter how he felt about me or how he felt about my…
But on stage, no, it was Nat Cole.
